notes.page_content: One handwritten cancelled algebra draft in two principal columns, a boxed left system, a longer right system and descending equality chain, local cancellations/annotations, two upside-down remnants at the left foot, and a circled beta=0.
notes.author_own_uncertainty_comment: No explicit author uncertainty words or question marks were read. Editorial uncertainty in reading.tex records uncertain strokes, not supplied manuscript wording.
notes.title_date_page_counts: No title, date or author page number read. Pencilled archive numeral 3 at upper-left edge is a comment only. H page 3 is the expected scan-minus-one locator.
mathematics_led_reading_decisions: The unqualified f_{i+1} annotation beneath f_i f_1 is preserved as written; the nearby boxed rule has separate parity cases. No condition was supplied.
The expansion indices were read separately in all six locations where H uses 1 for the indexed i. Their dotted/short strokes decide the readings.

The coefficient (1−alpha) was inspected in crop 09 because the attachment of its dash to 1 can resemble a plus. The crop shows one numeral stroke and a rightward dash; the minus reading is retained without doubt.
The lower second-case eta subscript remains i−1/i+1 despite the earlier formula using i+1. No mathematical repair was made.
The beta=0 and alpha=±1 conclusions are transcribed as written. No proof of those conclusions was claimed or checked.
notes.global_cancellation_collation: C marks every block deleted. H initial editorial note explicitly reports the two large diagonal cancellations; that note already conveys the same overall state, so no artificial global-deletion difference is counted. The local cancellation omissions are collated separately.
notes.H_editorial_apparatus: H note contents were read as editorial descriptions and were not transcribed as manuscript. The unmarked body labels Encadré/pour and À droite/pour are identified separately as non-ink words. H vertical-layout note acknowledges the descending chain; the body repetition needed for its horizontal rendering is recorded as placement.
notes.inventory_coverage: All 31 supplied C inventory items were individually visually checked and represented. Additional explicit inventory items record archive numeral, underline, circle, enclosure, small dot and initials.
notes.independence: Read only assigned brief, packet, PREAMBLE, notation snapshot, and the three assigned scan images; no OCR, external sources, other pages, other readers, or delegation.
notes.record_validation: Confirmed all required difference fields, all 14 crop files, all 37 inventory entries, and agreement between 10 unsure markers in reading.tex and 10 open doubt records. The 12 supplied C doubt loci have 3 resolved and 9 retained statuses.

brief_feedback: The brief distinguishes H note apparatus from manuscript. H also has descriptive body labels outside note macros (Encadré, pour; À droite, pour); these are explicitly identified as non-ink body words so the root can choose their collation treatment.
The small isolated dark dot left of the cancelled xf_1 has no secure syntactic role. It is preserved with a doubtful dot candidate instead of being silently discarded.
The source inventory calls the hand Grothendieck; this report uses the brief-required hand value his hand. The pencilled archive numeral is assigned another unnamed hand.
